invariants.description: A workflow must have at least one trigger node.
invariants.rule: Every workflow must contain at least one node of type 'trigger'.

invariants.description: Workflow name must be unique per user.
invariants.rule: A user cannot have two workflows with the same name.
Every connection must have sourceNodeId and targetNodeId that exist in the workflow's nodes array.
Once a workflow is activated, its version cannot be modified; changes create a new version.

invariants.description: Only users with editor role can modify workflows.
invariants.rule: Workflow creation and editing require the 'editor' role or higher.
